name: Comparison 3
description: 4-product feature matrix with a rounded highlight ring around the hero column, tri-state check/minus/cross marks, and JS-generated stacked cards on mobile.
interactions: highlight ring built from per-cell 2px side borders on the hero column, capped by a top-radius border on the header cell and a bottom-radius border on the last row (no wrapper element)
below 768px the table hides and a stacked card list (one card group per feature, one row per product) is generated by JS from the same data matrix on load
static otherwise — no hover, scroll, or timed behavior in the reference

layout.container: 1024px table wrap centered inside the section, 768px header
